cbc.name: Complete Blood Count (CBC)
cbc.reason: Evaluates overall health, detects infections, anemia, and blood disorders

blood_glucose.name: Blood Glucose Test
blood_glucose.reason: Measures blood sugar levels to detect diabetes or hypoglycemia

hba1c.name: HbA1c (Glycated Hemoglobin)
hba1c.reason: Shows average blood sugar over past 2-3 months for diabetes monitoring

urine_test.name: Urinalysis
urine_test.reason: Detects urinary infections, kidney issues, and metabolic conditions

urine_culture.name: Urine Culture
urine_culture.reason: Identifies specific bacteria causing urinary tract infections

thyroid_panel.name: Thyroid Function Panel
thyroid_panel.reason: Measures thyroid hormones (T3, T4, TSH) to assess thyroid function

chest_xray.name: Chest X-Ray
chest_xray.reason: Visualizes lungs and heart to detect infections, tumors, or abnormalities

ecg.name: Electrocardiogram (ECG/EKG)
ecg.reason: Records heart's electrical activity to detect arrhythmias and heart conditions

stress_test.name: Cardiac Stress Test
stress_test.reason: Evaluates heart function during physical exertion

angiography.name: Coronary Angiography
angiography.reason: Visualizes heart blood vessels to detect blockages

stool_test.name: Stool Analysis
stool_test.reason: Detects infections, parasites, or digestive issues

endoscopy.name: Upper GI Endoscopy
endoscopy.reason: Visualizes esophagus, stomach, and duodenum for ulcers or inflammation

colonoscopy.name: Colonoscopy
colonoscopy.reason: Examines the colon for polyps, inflammation, or cancer

h_pylori_test.name: H. Pylori Test
h_pylori_test.reason: Detects Helicobacter pylori bacteria causing stomach ulcers

flu_test.name: Influenza Rapid Test
flu_test.reason: Quickly detects influenza A or B viruses

malaria_smear.name: Malaria Blood Smear
malaria_smear.reason: Identifies malaria parasites in blood under microscope

dengue_test.name: Dengue NS1 Antigen Test
dengue_test.reason: Detects dengue virus in early infection stage

platelet_count.name: Platelet Count
platelet_count.reason: Monitors platelet levels, critical in dengue and bleeding disorders

blood_culture.name: Blood Culture
blood_culture.reason: Identifies bacteria or fungi in bloodstream causing infection

ultrasound.name: Ultrasound
ultrasound.reason: Non-invasive imaging for organs, pregnancy, and soft tissue

ct_scan.name: CT Scan
ct_scan.reason: Detailed cross-sectional imaging for internal organs and structures

mri_brain.name: Brain MRI
mri_brain.reason: Detailed brain imaging for neurological conditions

mri_spine.name: Spine MRI
mri_spine.reason: Detailed spinal imaging for disc and nerve issues

xray.name: X-Ray
xray.reason: Basic imaging for bones and joints

sinus_xray.name: Sinus X-Ray
sinus_xray.reason: Visualizes sinus cavities to detect sinusitis

spirometry.name: Spirometry (Lung Function Test)
spirometry.reason: Measures lung capacity and airflow for respiratory conditions

peak_flow.name: Peak Flow Measurement
peak_flow.reason: Quick assessment of breathing capacity for asthma monitoring

iron_studies.name: Iron Studies Panel
iron_studies.reason: Evaluates iron levels and storage for anemia diagnosis

vitamin_b12.name: Vitamin B12 Test
vitamin_b12.reason: Checks B12 levels which affect nerve function and blood cells

vitamin_d_test.name: Vitamin D Test
vitamin_d_test.reason: Checks vitamin D levels important for bone health

electrolytes.name: Electrolyte Panel
electrolytes.reason: Measures sodium, potassium, and other essential minerals

kidney_function.name: Kidney Function Test (Creatinine, BUN)
kidney_function.reason: Evaluates kidney health and filtration ability

uric_acid.name: Uric Acid Test
uric_acid.reason: Measures uric acid levels for gout diagnosis

rheumatoid_factor.name: Rheumatoid Factor Test
rheumatoid_factor.reason: Detects antibodies associated with rheumatoid arthritis

joint_fluid_analysis.name: Joint Fluid Analysis (Arthrocentesis)
joint_fluid_analysis.reason: Examines joint fluid for infection, gout, or arthritis

lumbar_puncture.name: Lumbar Puncture (Spinal Tap)
lumbar_puncture.reason: Analyzes cerebrospinal fluid for meningitis or neurological diseases

neurological_exam.name: Neurological Examination
neurological_exam.reason: Assesses nervous system function and reflexes

vestibular_test.name: Vestibular Function Test
vestibular_test.reason: Evaluates inner ear and balance function

nerve_conduction.name: Nerve Conduction Study
nerve_conduction.reason: Tests electrical conduction in nerves for neuropathy

sleep_study.name: Polysomnography (Sleep Study)
sleep_study.reason: Monitors sleep patterns to diagnose sleep disorders

psychological_evaluation.name: Psychological Evaluation
psychological_evaluation.reason: Comprehensive assessment for mental health conditions

hormone_panel.name: Hormone Panel
hormone_panel.reason: Measures various hormones for endocrine disorders

ultrasound_pelvis.name: Pelvic Ultrasound
ultrasound_pelvis.reason: Visualizes reproductive organs for PCOS and other conditions

ph_monitoring.name: Esophageal pH Monitoring
ph_monitoring.reason: Measures acid levels in esophagus for GERD diagnosis

physical_exam.name: Physical Examination
physical_exam.reason: General assessment of body systems and vital signs
